name: Story Writer Skill
purpose: Rulebook for phase 2: arc, beat map, hook, planned visual beats and narration script, a research feedback loop, a completion checklist with sign-off in qa/story-review.json, and a retro loop that records and promotes story lessons.
capabilities: Rule-based story structure from the brief, arc and pinned style template
Goal and share trigger, five or more hooks gated on truth and pull, packaging (title, cover, search phrase)
Research gap requests traced to beats and claims
26-point completion checklist and signed verdict, enforced as a warning by studio.py validate
Lesson log with an evidence-based promotion rule, analytics reading table and A/B test discipline

installation.instructions: Workspace file; no separate installation. Run by the story-writer subagent (.claude/agents/story-writer.md).

compatibility.notes: Light commands only (studio.py hook/script/style/validate, beatmap.py); never takes the host lock.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; consolidates existing workspace rules, no third-party text copied.

security.notes: Writes project story files and qa/story-review.json; runs light workspace CLIs.

approval_evidence: New on 2026-11-06; not yet used on a film.
